about_the_game:
Game Description

You will go undercover as a security guard to infiltrate the Jinxiu Apartment complex, which is slated for demolition. The building is shrouded in the shadow of serial murders: a female author's bizarre hanging, an editor's mysterious drowning, a security guard's accidental fall, and a resident's brutal stabbing. All the while, the killer, calling himself "Frogman," openly boasts about his crimes online...

Your true identity is a journalist seeking the truth. By day, you must handle the residents' daily needs to maintain your cover; by night, you must meticulously watch the building's surveillance monitors—covering the lobby, elevators, rooftop, parking garage, and more. Use the unique "Frame-level Investigation" system to capture every clue and piece together the full picture of the events.

Probing online, reviewing footage, searching the web—every step may bring you closer to the truth, but you must remain vigilant. As the warning circulating among the residents says: "That serial killer... they say he never left the building."

Game Features

A hardcore, surveillance-driven detective experience, a suspenseful narrative structure with multiple intertwined cases, and an immersive, dark atmosphere.

  • Details are the Truth Capture abnormal behavior in real-time surveillance and lock down key timelines by reviewing historical footage. Use the "Frame-level Investigation" system to analyze footage frame by frame. Circle suspicious persons, objects, behaviors, or time points to convert them into saveable clue entries.

  • Closed-Loop Clue Puzzles Consolidate all clues—entries extracted from surveillance, information from dialogues, and evidence from web searches—into your cluebook. When specific conditions are met, the system will automatically trigger clue associations. Drag the correct fragments of information into the deduction interface, fill in the logical blanks, generate key storyboards, and advance the plot.

Core Gameplay Guide

  • Surveillance Investigation: Monitor all areas of the building around the clock, letting no suspicious detail escape.

  • Clue Collection & Integration: Gather evidence through multiple channels to build a complete chain of clues.

  • Character Interaction & Plot Progression: Interact with the various characters in the apartment, extracting key information through dialogue.

content_descriptors.notes: Some of the game's video content and lines may contain: "partial nudity", "sexual references", "violence", etc. and may not be suitable for all ages.

short_description: A strange murder case, broke the peace of Jinxiao apartment. As a new night security guard, your only weapons are the surveillance systems throughout the building and the word of the occupants. And the truth is hidden between your surveillance screen and your reasoning notes.
